mapping.draft_py:
# Vampire Gourmand (FDN), a 2/2 Vampire for {1}{B}.
# "Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, draw a card and
#  this creature can't be blocked this turn."
# Event: Library Larcenist's verified "Whenever this creature attacks" (DeclareAttackersEvent over
#   IS_SOURCE).
# Effect: M21 Dire Fleet Warmonger's verified "you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, ..."
#   (Seq of OptionalEffect(SACRIFICE another creature you control), then Conditional(MAY_DONE)).
#   The "If you do" body is a Seq in printed order: M21 Crypt Lurker's verified "draw a card"
#   (B5b-cont-draw), then M21 Ghostly Pilferer's verified "This creature can't be blocked this
#   turn" (PREVENT_EFFECT of the block declaration against the source, until end of turn).
attack = TriggeredAbility(
    event=DeclareAttackersEvent(filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
    condition=None,
    effect=Seq(
        steps=(
            OptionalEffect(
                inner=A(Verb.SACRIFICE, {
                    'target': Selector(
                        count=QConst(value=1),
                        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                        filter=FAnd(
                            children=(
                                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                                FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
                            ),
                        ),
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                    ),
                }),
            ),
            Conditional(
                pred=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.MAY_DONE),
                then_effect=Seq(
                    steps=(
                        A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
                        A(Verb.PREVENT_EFFECT, {
                            'condition': FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                            'duration': DurationEot(),
                            'event': DeclareBlockersEvent(
                                filter=FAnd(children=()),
                                blocked=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                            ),
                        }),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [attack, *compiled]

If you do, draw a card and this creature can't be blocked this turn.
